title: Migrate Chatticus marketing site (chattic.us): standard header/footer and Markus prose

comments.author: home
comments.text: Migration built on branch feature/PPY-ef96e1-papyrus-standard-front-end in Chattic.us-web (commit 068c180, local): whole public site is a standard Papyrus static site (web/projection.json, site-theme.css, 150-line hooks.py; Markus pages with page blocks; WorkspaceDemo/mark/forms/confirm+invite as islands; social previews built; offers and worked examples single-sourced). Decision: forms stay app code as islands because core forms cannot express the intake payloads (contact_type + nested details, two-phase abandoned-lead survey with dynamic questions, token pages); everything else migrated. Parity vs live (82 URLs): all present, text identical on 57, 12 within 3% (chatticus docs drift since last deploy), explained diffs on 13; head metadata diffs allow-listed. Blocked on: core page-blocks release (PR #424 open, python check failing); PyPI 5.2.0/5.3.0 do not contain it.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live and verified. PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Chattic.us-web/pull/37 merged to main (bed1cea) after sh scripts/ci-local.sh passed with papyrus-newsroom 5.4.0 (core page blocks: PR 424, released as 5.4.0). Deploy: scripts/deploy-local.sh with profile chatticus-production, account 340169921348, cdk diff verdict ok (only the DeployWebsite source zip key changed; distribution E19HVP4WEUJ7SV and the intake stack untouched), live copy smoke clean. The chatticus-marketing pipeline could not do it: its Verify project still has the pre-humanus buildspec and has been failing since #36 (follow-up PPY-5e3d24). Live verification: 163 page URLs (82 canonical, plus the slashless forms) return 200 text/html; all 274 built files fetched from https://chattic.us are byte-identical to the build; /api/waitlist/survey 200, /chat 403 as before; screenshots of 13 key pages at 1440 and 390 match the old look (page height within 2.5% except the worked-example pages, which now render the intended design: live was missing the Tailwind classes lib/use-case-page.tsx used). Parity (82 URLs vs the live crawl): text identical 57, within 3% 12 (chatticus docs moved since the last deploy; identical to today's old build), explained differences 13 (client-rendered forms and demo, FAQ answers now in the HTML, wiki group headings kept via card hook); head metadata unexplained diffs 0. Code: 3270 added, 6666 removed (TypeScript/TSX +410 -4289, Python +790 -1298, CSS +893 -799, Markdown +770 -125). Follow-ups: PPY-5e3d24 (redeploy pipeline stack), PPY-9cd419 (core gaps). Decision recorded: the intake forms, survey, confirm and invite pages stay islands because core forms cannot express the intake payloads.
